title: Mimbar jaane haider jaane
body:
Mimbar jaane haider jaane
[Chhed diya hai zikr e maula
<<DIVIDER>>
mimbar jaane haider jaane]..(2)
kufr hai gar ye ishq ali ka
<<DIVIDER>>
kafar jaane haider jaane
1. Binte asad to jaengi har haal me kaabe ke andar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
darr hogi deewar kaha se
maadar jaane haider jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ismaeel ye soch rahe the
kyu gardan par haath rakhu
<<DIVIDER>>
naam e ali hai mere labo par
khanjar jaane haider jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Fatha likhi hai daste khuda par ab bhi mere pyaare habeeb..(2)
naade aliyan kehke bulale
<<DIVIDER>>
khaiber jaane haider jaane
4. Aarefa e aijaz e ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maadar hai ummat to nahi
bint e asad ko fikr nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ajdar jaane haider jaane
5. Jung e ohod me mera maula shaakh se sar karta hai qalam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
tegh falak se aae na aae
lashkar jaane haider jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ishq e ali ke dawe daro
rabb ki ibadat lazim hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh kar mat jaan chhudao
mehshar jaane haider jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sher e khuda ka pota hai ye kehkar maa ne bhej diya..(2)
ladta hai ab kese rann me
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar jaane haider jaane
8. Shaam me aur meraj nabi me
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hi lehja goya tha
kisne rakha hai kiska parda
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtar jaane haider jaane
9. Mir hasan aur sibt e jafar
<<DIVIDER>>
banda e haider hai dono
inke kafan par likhwa dena
<<DIVIDER>>
naukar jaane haider jaane
author: Mir Hassan Mir
